E1.evidence: Issue #32 (opened and closed by maintainer jihoonl): "From indigo, Publisher complains not having queue_size arguement.."; closed with a link to the fixing commit 5ee65b0, which adds queue_size to the rospy.Publisher calls.

E2.evidence: rospy (ros/ros_comm) and kobuki_dashboard (yujinrobot/kobuki_desktop) are separately released packages. In ros_comm 8b430368 ("add warning when queue_size is omitted for rospy publisher (#346)", first released after 1.11.0) the provider changed the contract of rospy.Publisher: calls that omit queue_size now trigger warnings.warn("The publisher should be created with an explicit keyword argument 'queue_size'. ...", SyntaxWarning, ...). kobuki_dashboard still constructs rospy.Publisher(topic, Led) and rospy.Publisher(topic, MotorPower) without it. The warning depends on the consumer's call form against the provider's newer declaration, and the fix is a change to how the consumer calls the provider API, not a name binding or build change.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: rospy at Indigo ("From indigo") runs newer than the rospy revision whose Publisher contract the kobuki_dashboard code matches (queue_size omitted without a warning, up to ros_comm 1.11.0).

E4.evidence: Observed warning: "Publisher complains not having queue_size arguement.."

units.name: rospy
units.revision_basis: The reporter names only the distro ("From indigo") on 2014-08-08; the latest ros_comm Indigo release tag before that date is 1.11.8 (af735bb8, 2014-08-04), which contains the warning added in 8b430368 (released after 1.11.0). The resolution does not change rospy.

units.name: kobuki_dashboard
units.revision_basis: Broken: f04c615c is the parent of the fix commit (both 2014-08-08, the issue date); kobuki_dashboard/src/kobuki_dashboard/led_widget.py and motor_widget.py there call rospy.Publisher(topic, Led) and rospy.Publisher(topic, MotorPower). Resolved: the fix commit 5ee65b0, which passes queue_size=5.

failed_conditions.quote: From indigo, Publisher complains not having queue_size arguement..

loudness_evidence: The provider emits a warning when the publisher is created: "From indigo, Publisher complains not having queue_size arguement.." (https://github.com/yujinrobot/kobuki_desktop/issues/32); the provider code issuing it is warnings.warn("The publisher should be created with an explicit keyword argument 'queue_size'. " ... SyntaxWarning, stacklevel=2) (https://github.com/ros/ros_comm/commit/8b43036842926cc9a351d37cd888537fd2797eb0).

resolution.summary: Pass an explicit queue_size to every rospy.Publisher the consumer creates (queue_size=5 in led_widget.py and motor_widget.py).
resolution.evidence: The issue was closed by linking the commit ("https://github.com/yujinrobot/kobuki_desktop/commit/5ee65b061a4a919b2a32e80087f4cb3e51e924ed"); no run of the resolved composition is shown.

notes: Class 'other': the rospy.Publisher signature did not change (queue_size was already an optional keyword); the provider began warning about the call form that omits it ("When the keyword is not being used or when None is passed all publishing will happen synchronously and a warning message will be printed."), as planned in ros_comm #346 ("For indigo we should make the new behavior default."). consumer_built_against is inferred: 1.11.0 (09e1d5eb) is the parent of the warning commit 8b430368 and the last ros_comm tag whose rospy.Publisher accepts an omitted queue_size silently; the kobuki_dashboard code itself dates from 2013 (Groovy/Hydro era). The same defect in another composition: kobuki_qtestsuite's testsuite_widget.py (rospy.Publisher(..., Twist) -> queue_size=10), fixed in the same commit. The commit also contains an unrelated UPGRADE adaptation in kobuki_qtestsuite to an rqt_plot API change (rqt_plot.mat_data_plot.MatDataPlot replaced by rqt_plot.data_plot.DataPlot); that is a different composition and not a condition of this case.
